title: Unit 21 Consolidation: Work, Wages and Workers' Rights
goal: I can use the words for precarious work, wages and workers' rights.
I can use concession, sentences without a doer and -va/-ve results.
I can use scalar adverbs and *köteles* when writing about pay and rights.
